home.metaTitle: IronVibe — offline workout log, no ads, no subscriptions
home.philosophy1: Our philosophy is minimalism and functionality. No subscriptions, no ads. This app is yours. Forever.
home.philosophy2: Whether you're a pro athlete or a beginner, a coach with 30 years of experience or still looking for your first client — IronVibe is your reliable companion on any path. We don't teach you how to train; we give you the tools to do it more effectively.
home.feature1Desc: Coach or athlete — the app follows your role. Each client gets their own history, progress, and favorites, even offline.
home.feature2Desc: Best sets, estimated 1RM, and max volume in one table. Search a name, star favorites, open the chart.
home.feature3Desc: Star what you actually train and tag a muscle group. IronVibe can assemble a full-body session from your own list.
home.feature4Desc: You name the exercises. No preset programs, no bulky database — the log stays in your words.
home.feature5Desc: No account, no ads, no subscription. Your data lives on the device and goes nowhere else.
home.feature6Desc: History, favorites, and muscle tags fit into a single file. That copy exists only once you save it — and loads back the same way.
home.hofPatronsEmpty: Empty for now. This is where the names of everyone who backed the project go.
home.supportLead: IronVibe runs without ads, subscriptions, or outside money. If the app has earned its place on your phone, a transfer covers the developer account, the domain, and the time behind new versions.
home.supportNote: It's a gesture, not a purchase: the app has no paid features and never will.
home.supportHofNote: Everyone who backs the project gets a line in the Hall of Fame.
home.privacyTeaser: We collect no analytics and set no cookies.

privacy.intro: Current version for the IronVibe app. Full text also available at ironvibe.app/privacy.
privacy.s1Body: We take your privacy seriously. IronVibe is designed to collect as little data as possible and to keep your training data under your control. This document describes what data the IronVibe app and website process and how.
privacy.s2Intro: The IronVibe app does not require an account and does not ask for your name, email, or other directly identifying information.
privacy.s2List1: workout history, exercises, notes, and related parameters (weight, reps, rest, etc.);
privacy.s2List2: client/athlete data you enter (e.g. name, training goal);
privacy.s2List3: local app settings (language, display options, etc.).
privacy.s2Outro: This data exists only on your device and is not sent to us automatically.
privacy.s3P1: All workout and settings data is stored locally on your device. We do not upload it to our servers or have direct access to it.
privacy.s3P2: You can delete your data at any time: clear the workout history in the app, or uninstall the app — local data is permanently removed with it.
privacy.s4P1: There is none. IronVibe ships without a single analytics, tracking, or crash-reporting library — no Google Analytics, no Firebase, no advertising SDKs. You can verify it: the app source code is public.
privacy.s4P2: The app sends nothing to our servers, because we do not run any. It reaches the network only when you open an external link yourself (the website or Telegram, for example) — from that point you are on that service's side.
privacy.s4P3: If you installed IronVibe from Google Play, the store keeps its own install and crash statistics under Google's rules. We do not control that and receive no personal data from it.
privacy.s5Title: 5. The website: cookies and browser storage
privacy.s5P1: ironvibe.app sets no cookies and runs no counters, pixels, or advertising scripts. The only thing kept in your browser is the theme you picked, light or dark — an interface setting you choose yourself, which disappears when you clear site data.
privacy.s5P2: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any host, GitHub processes technical request data (including IP addresses) to deliver pages and defend against abuse, under its own privacy policy. Those logs never reach us.
privacy.s6P1: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing.
privacy.s6List1: technical processing by the website host and by Google Play, in the scope described in sections 4 and 5 and under their own policies;
privacy.s6List2: to comply with the law or lawful requests by authorities;
privacy.s6List3: when you share data yourself — for example, sending your backup file to someone else.
privacy.s7P1: Because most data is stored only on your device, you control it through the app and system settings.
privacy.s7List1: You can delete workouts, clients, and any other records right inside IronVibe.
privacy.s7List2: You can restrict app permissions (e.g. network) in your OS settings.
privacy.s7List3: You can limit data collection at the device and Google account level, where the platform supports it.
privacy.s7Outro: If you have questions about what data is used or how to delete it, contact us at support@ironvibe.app.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version is always at ironvibe.app/privacy. For material changes we will try to notify you (e.g. via an app update or a notice on the site).
privacy.s9Body: For questions about this Privacy Policy, data processing, or IronVibe in general, write to us at support@ironvibe.app. We will aim to reply as soon as reasonably possible.
privacy.footerNote: The current full version of this policy is always available at ironvibe.app/privacy.
